generation_attempt.identity_rule: attempt_id is unique per ordered call; body_id is SHA-256 of source after newline normalization; duplicate attempts remain separate records

diagnostic_probe.feature_rule: Exactly one row per each of 30 probes in the frozen family-major order; error/timeout/invalid/wrong count as failure; incomplete battery has no k/C

evaluation_input.identity_rule: input_id is SHA-256 of canonical JSON for n, edges, s, t

evaluation_outcome.rule: Complete records retain raw solver/oracle outputs and boolean correctness; each body/input pair is separately identified

feature_record.invariant: k equals sum of six family_counts; C equals max(family_counts)/k for k>0 and 0 for k=0
